description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for an OpenCart extension API related to coupons. It processes incoming requests to retrieve coupon information for a specific order, extracting coupon code from order totals, and rendering a view with the coupon data.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class handling API requests for coupon information within the OpenCart admin extension.
